acanthus-tailpiece.description: An upright spray in black penwork rising from a short cut stem at the bottom, a tall curling acanthus leaf in the centre with finely hatched lobes, two large acanthus leaves curling down and outward to the left and right, a small ivy leaf and a thin tendril at the upper right, a tendril at the upper left and a hanging flower bud below the stem, on a transparent background.
acanthus-tailpiece.title: Penwork acanthus tailpiece
usage_notes: Place centred below the last paragraph of a chapter or section; pairs with songbirds-headpiece at the head of the text.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

clasped-book-and-ivy.description: A closed book seen from above in three-quarter view, in black penwork, with its spine of raised bands at the left, two strap clasps on the right edge of the hatched front cover, a bevelled cover border with corner bosses, visible page edges and a ribbon bookmark hanging out of the fore-edge at the bottom, surrounded on both sides and below by an ivy vine of pointed leaves and curled tendrils, on a transparent background.
clasped-book-and-ivy.title: Clasped book among ivy
usage_notes: Complete vignette; keep the book and its ivy together and keep the proportions.
Open line art; the cover and page interiors are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

gold-cinquefoil-divider-center.description: A painted five-petalled flower in textured gold with dark brown contours, pale cream highlights along the petal veins and a dark brown centre, with a short gold stem ending in a round knob on each side, on a transparent background.
gold-cinquefoil-divider-center.title: Gold cinquefoil divider, centre
usage_notes: Centre piece of a flexible divider with gold-cinquefoil-divider-end; draw a continuous rule beneath it so the knobbed stems meet the rule on both sides.
Also works alone as a section mark.

gold-cinquefoil-divider-end.description: A painted divider terminal in textured gold with dark brown contours and pale cream highlights, a three-lobed ivy leaf pointing left with a smaller lobe curling up and one curling down behind it, and a long straight gold stem extending to the right, on a transparent background.
gold-cinquefoil-divider-end.title: Gold ivy-leaf divider terminal
usage_notes: Terminal of a flexible divider with gold-cinquefoil-divider-center; the leaf points left and the stem runs right, so as drawn it closes the left end of a rule and is mirrored for the right end.
Draw the connecting rule at the height of the stem.

gold-lozenge-divider-center.description: A painted lozenge-shaped fleuron in textured gold with dark brown contours and pale cream highlights, a tall pointed leaf above and below and a curled leaf to the left and right around a small dark brown centre, with a straight gold stem ending in a pointed tip on each side, on a transparent background.
gold-lozenge-divider-center.title: Gold lozenge divider, centre
usage_notes: Centre piece of a flexible divider with gold-lozenge-divider-end; draw a continuous rule beneath it so the pointed stems meet the rule on both sides.
Also works alone as a section mark.

gold-lozenge-divider-end.description: A painted divider terminal in textured gold with dark brown contours and pale cream highlights, a pointed acanthus leaf pointing left with a scroll curling up above it and one curling down below it, and a long straight gold stem extending to the right, on a transparent background.
gold-lozenge-divider-end.title: Gold acanthus divider terminal
usage_notes: Terminal of a flexible divider with gold-lozenge-divider-center; the leaf points left and the stem runs right, so as drawn it closes the left end of a rule and is mirrored for the right end.
Draw the connecting rule at the height of the stem.

ivy-corner-bottom-left.description: A bottom-left corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex under a cluster of curled acanthus leaves, with an ivy vine climbing the vertical rule and running along the horizontal one, pointed ivy leaves with veined interiors, curled tendrils and a curled leaf closing each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
ivy-corner-bottom-left.title: Ivy corner, bottom-left
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and close with curled leaves, not finials.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

ivy-corner-bottom-right.description: A bottom-right corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex under a cluster of curled acanthus leaves, with an ivy vine climbing the vertical rule and running along the horizontal one, pointed ivy leaves with veined interiors, curled tendrils and a fleur-de-lis finial capping each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
ivy-corner-bottom-right.title: Ivy corner, bottom-right
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-right of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and end in finials, so they are not meant to be extended.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

ivy-corner-top-left.description: A top-left corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex, with an ivy vine winding down the vertical rule and along the horizontal one, pointed three-lobed ivy leaves with veined interiors, small curled tendrils and a fleur-de-lis finial capping each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
ivy-corner-top-left.title: Ivy corner, top-left
usage_notes: Place at the top-left of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and end in finials, so they are not meant to be extended.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

ivy-corner-top-right.description: A top-right corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex under a large curled acanthus leaf, with an ivy vine winding down the vertical rule and a shorter run of tendrils along the horizontal one, pointed ivy leaves with veined interiors, curled tendrils and a curled leaf closing each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
ivy-corner-top-right.title: Ivy corner, top-right
usage_notes: Place at the top-right of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and close with curled leaves, not finials.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.

ivy-fleuron.description: A compact symmetric fleuron in black penwork, three pointed three-lobed ivy leaves on short stems that join at a single stalk below, the middle leaf upright and the outer two turned outward, with a heavy outer contour and fine veins inside, on a transparent background.
ivy-fleuron.title: Ivy fleuron
usage_notes: Small standalone mark for a section break or a line end; the stalk at the bottom is where it meets a rule or baseline.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

ivy-flower-divider.description: A long horizontal divider in black penwork, a waving stem carrying pointed ivy leaves, three five-petalled flowers with hatched petals, two curling hatched acanthus leaves and small spiral tendrils, ending in an ivy leaf at the left and an ivy leaf with a tendril at the right, on a transparent background.
ivy-flower-divider.title: Ivy and flower divider
usage_notes: Complete flourish with two different finished ends; use as a whole image, do not tile or stretch it.
Wide 6:1 piece; it sits as a section break or beneath a heading.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves and petals are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

ivy-line-filler.description: A slender horizontal line filler in black penwork, a gently waving stem with four pointed ivy leaves on short stalks, a five-petalled flower at the centre, small curled tendrils above and below the stem and a small lozenge terminal at each end, on a transparent background.
ivy-line-filler.title: Ivy line filler
usage_notes: Complete piece with finished lozenge ends; use as a whole image, do not tile or stretch it.
Thin and about 6:1; it sits between paragraphs or fills the end of a short line.

ivy-manuscript-frame.description: A complete landscape rectangular frame in black penwork, a thin double rule on all four sides with an ivy vine of pointed three-lobed leaves and curled tendrils running along the outside of the rules, curled acanthus leaves and small finials at the four corners and a small ivy spray at the middle of the top and bottom rules, around a transparent opening, on a transparent background.
ivy-manuscript-frame.title: Ruled ivy frame
usage_notes: Fixed complete frame with a transparent centre; scale it proportionally as one image, its sides are not repeat tiles and it is not a border-image atlas.
Same double rule and ivy as the four separate ivy corners, which serve the same kit on pages of another proportion.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

ivy-marginal-vine.description: A tall narrow vertical vine in black penwork, a sinuous stem with alternating pointed ivy leaves and curled, hatched acanthus leaves to either side, small spiral tendrils along its length, a pointed ivy leaf as the top terminal and a curled leaf as the bottom terminal, on a transparent background.
ivy-marginal-vine.title: Ivy margin vine
usage_notes: Standalone vertical margin ornament about 1:4; keep it upright and use it whole, it has no rule and no repeat unit.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

songbirds-headpiece.description: A wide symmetric headpiece in black penwork, two long-tailed songbirds perched on a branching stem and facing each other across a central upright ivy leaf, with solid black ivy leaves, curled tendrils and small berry clusters spreading to both sides, the birds and leaves drawn with transparent hatching, on a transparent background.
songbirds-headpiece.title: Songbirds headpiece
usage_notes: Place above a title or at the head of a chapter; do not tile or stretch it.
Wide 3:1 piece; pairs with acanthus-tailpiece at the end of the text.
Heavier than the other penwork pieces, with solid black leaves; it holds up on darker grounds better than the open line art.
